def process(load_fraud_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_fraud_data.copy()
    df.columns = ['metropolitan_area', 'fraud_reports']
    df = df[df['metropolitan_area'].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[df['metropolitan_area'] != 'Metropolitan Area'].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df[~df['metropolitan_area'].str.contains('Source:', na=False)].reset_index(drop=True)
    df['fraud_reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['fraud_reports'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['fraud_reports'].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def process(clean_fraud_data, clean_identity_theft_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = clean_fraud_data.merge(clean_identity_theft_data, on='metropolitan_area', how='inner')
    merged['theft_exceeds_fraud'] = merged['theft_reports'] > merged['fraud_reports']
    return merged
